chapters.label: Frankfurt, 1993
chapters.text: Frankfurt, 1993. Eintracht against Karlsruhe, three minutes to go. Uwe Bein could shoot, but he lays the ball back to Jay-Jay Okocha, right in the box.

chapters.label: The dance
chapters.text: Now watch him dance. He cuts one way, then the other. He beats the defenders, and Oliver Kahn ends up on the grass!

chapters.label: The gap
chapters.text: Five changes of direction in eleven seconds. Then he finds the gap, and scores! Three–one.

chapters.label: Stay calm
chapters.text: Stay calm in the box. Quick changes of direction can beat defenders, and even the keeper.
